cases.rationale: Full-reference MgO + WO3 partial reaction with 50 wt% wolframite MgWO4, 7.41 wt% residual MgO and 42.59 wt% monoclinic WO3 at an exact 1:1 Mg:W balance. This is an easier transfer variation of the unresolved hidden-wolframite/watch-list case: no phase is withheld, but the weak light-element MgO tests complete inventory while the three phases require distinct profile treatment.

Four-phase BaCO3 + WO3 partial reaction/intermediate mixture containing ordered scheelite BaWO4, rhombohedral Ba3W2O9, residual witherite and monoclinic WO3 at an exact 1:1 Ba:W balance. Ba3W2O9 retains its exact reference because no tier-1/2 framework survives withholding. The ordered BaWO4 truth is naturally absent: the sole exact-composition COD record is split/disordered, while the nearest physical survivor is tier-1 SrWO4 COD 1546036 (Sr->Ba, framework RMS 0.0000, 6.49% cell mismatch). This tests generalization of physical source rejection and analogue adaptation inside a new four-phase carbonate/off-stoichiometric pattern.
